description: This Java interface defines the structure and behavior for authorization context management within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating, modifying, and evaluating authorization subjects and contexts, as well as JSON serialization details.

classes.name: AuthorizationContext.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains static definitions of JSON fields used in serialization of AuthorizationContext instances.

methods.name: authorizationContext.newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new immutable AuthorizationContext with specified type and authorization subjects.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of this authorization context.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Retrieves all authorization subjects contained in this context.

methods.name: addHead
methods.description: Returns a new authorization context with additional subjects added at the beginning.

methods.name: addTail
methods.description: Returns a new authorization context with additional subjects added at the end.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubjectIds
methods.description: Provides a list of IDs of all authorization subjects in this context.

methods.name: getFirstAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Returns the first authorization subject or empty if none exist.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of authorization subjects in the context.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether this context has no authorization subjects.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a stream of authorization subjects for processing.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Evaluates if this context grants authorization based on granted and revoked subjects.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the authorization context to a JSON object, including only non-hidden fields.
